answer: Proposed rule: at dawn, grant one daily AI vote per manufacturer-certified chip. Validators verify its certificate and fresh key/day signature, then anchor its serial to one key for 24 hours; duplicate bindings or invalid proofs get no vote. n eligible keys need n chips, so a key-generation spiral creates no free votes. Chips are reusable capital, not daily fees. Issuers must certify only one identity per physical chip: phantom certificates defeat this bound, and wealthy operators can still buy many chips.
